judge_context: Stop 1 of a research job (issue #4791): the turn that creates the project runs init-project and nothing else, then shows the researcher what they can act on. The hand-offs, the absence of any attached-record read, the source titles, the verify-or-research question and the closing "Continue with `choosing the question`?" line are checked by test_job_setup_stops_after_init_project. Do not re-grade them.

Grade the reply on what it tells the researcher: Jean Baptiste Moreau's birth (12 March 1821, Bastogne) and death (3 October 1889, Bastogne) as the tree gives them, his relatives by name and relationship (Marie Dubois; children Henri and Josephine), and his three attached sources by title. A reply that leaves out the vitals or the relatives is incomplete.
No question is chosen and nothing is planned or searched in this turn: that is correct, not missing work.

ROUTING IS NOT YOURS TO GRADE. The hand-offs and the fields named above are asserted deterministically from the hook records, which you cannot see. Grade only the router's own reply: whether it is honest about what it ran and delegated, and whether it reports what the steps returned without inventing anything.
